MATCH (p:Plugin {component: 'block_engagement'})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency:Plugin)
WHERE dependency.last_release_ts < (apoc.date.parse('2026-09-10', 's', 'yyyy-MM-dd') - (3 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60))
RETURN dependency.component, dependency.name, dependency.last_release_ts
LIMIT 100
